name: 原则：把教训编码进结构
description_zh: 当你第二次写同一条指令、或发现反复出现的纠正时：把规则编码成 lint、元数据标记、运行时检查或脚本，而不是更多文字。
description_en: Apply when you catch yourself writing the same instruction a second time, or notice a recurring correction. Encode the rule as a lint, metadata flag, runtime check, or script instead of more text.
